title: 5.2.5 Lab: Add a Jump
description: Gate a jump on a key press and a ground check. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add a ground-gated jump
steps.instructions: In draw(), when the jump key is pressed (edge-triggered) AND the player is touching the ground, set the player's vertical velocity to a negative number so it launches upward.
hints: Search the moSHion docs drawer for kb.presses and sprite.colliding.

requirements.title: Use an edge-triggered key check
requirements.description: The jump key uses kb.presses(...), which fires once per press.

requirements.title: Check that the player is on the ground
requirements.description: Somewhere in the sketch, the player is checked against another sprite with .colliding(...).

requirements.title: Combine both checks with &&
requirements.description: The jump is guarded by both the key press and the ground check together, joined with &&, so the player can't jump in mid-air.

requirements.title: Launch the player upward
requirements.description: Inside draw(), the player's vertical velocity is set to a negative number when the jump fires.
